title: This Tiny Island has Insane Traffic
summary: Not Just Bikes looks at traffic in the Bahamas to show that a small country can be just as car-centric as a big one. He ties it to land use, car dependence and how dedicated transit lanes help.
why: Pointed to as a good rant on car-brained design and as evidence that country size is not what drives car dependence.

quote.text: Not Just Bikes did a great rant on the carbrain of The Bahamas
